signups.measures: Completed self-serve account registrations, counted once per new account.
signups.normal_shape: Weekday-heavy. Saturdays and Sundays normally run well below weekdays.

checkout_errors.measures: HTTP 5xx responses returned by the checkout service during a payment attempt.
checkout_errors.normal_shape: Low and flat. A sustained rise means customers cannot pay.

api_latency_p95.measures: 95th percentile public API response time, as reported by the edge collector.
api_latency_p95.normal_shape: Steady with slow upward drift as traffic grows. Physically cannot be zero while the API serves traffic.

revenue.measures: Gross booked revenue from completed orders, before refunds.
revenue.normal_shape: Weekday-heavy and closely tracks signups, with a lag.

events.note: Search service v1.9 rolled out to 100% of traffic.
Signup form redesign shipped behind a flag at 50%.
Paid search budget raised 20% for the autumn quarter.
Long public-holiday weekend across the two largest markets; offices and most retail closed Saturday and Sunday.
Edge metrics collector migrated to the new OpenTelemetry agent. Dashboards were expected to be briefly unreliable.
OpenTelemetry agent rollback completed; collector back on the previous pipeline.
checkout-service v3.1.0 rollout began, including a new payment-provider SDK.
Black Friday email sequence started; three sends over the week.
US Thanksgiving public holiday. Most US business activity stops for the day.
Black Friday promotion live: 30% off all annual plans, homepage takeover, affiliate push.
Cyber Monday promotion, same discount as Black Friday.
